# box

## BOX_ADD_ALLOWED_COLLABORATION_DOMAIN
Creates a new entry in the list of allowed domains for collaboration within your enterprise. This allows you to whitelist specific domains for external collaboration. Use 'inbound' to allow users from the specified domain to collaborate on your enterprise's files and folders. Use 'outbound' to allow your enterprise users to collaborate on content owned by the specified domain. Use 'both' for bidirectional collaboration. Note: This action requires enterprise admin privileges and the 'manage_enterprise_properties' scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddAllowedCollaborationDomainRequest",
  "required": [
    "domain",
    "direction"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "domain": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Domain",
      "description": "The domain to add to the list of allowed collaboration domains (e.g., 'example.com'). This domain will be whitelisted for collaboration with your enterprise based on the specified direction."
    },
    "direction": {
      "enum": [
        "both",
        "inbound",
        "outbound"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Direction",
      "description": "The direction in which collaborations are allowed. Use 'inbound' to allow external users from this domain to collaborate on your content, 'outbound' to allow your users to collaborate on their content, or 'both' for bidirectional collaboration."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddAllowedCollaborationDomain`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_CLASSIFICATION_TO_FILE
Adds a classification to a file by specifying the label of the classification to add. **Enterprise-only feature**: This action requires a Box enterprise account with classification templates configured. Users without an enterprise account will receive an error when attempting to use this feature. This API can also be called by including the enterprise ID in the URL explicitly, for example `/files/:id//enterprise_12345/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddClassificationToFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "Box__Security__Classification__Key"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "Box__Security__Classification__Key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Box  Security  Classification  Key",
      "description": "The name of the classification to apply to this file. This is a required field. To list the available classifications in an enterprise, use the classification API to retrieve the [classification template](e://get_metadata_templates_enterprise_securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo_schema) which lists all available classification keys. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddClassificationToFile`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_CLASSIFICATION_TO_FOLDER
Adds a classification to a folder by specifying the label of the classification to add. **Enterprise-only feature**: This action requires a Box enterprise account with classification templates configured. Users without an enterprise account will receive an error when attempting to use this feature. **Prerequisites**: - A classification template must exist in the enterprise. Use `list_all_classifications` to retrieve available classification keys. - If no classifications exist, an admin must first create the classification template using `add_initial_classifications`. **Common errors**: - 404: Classification template not found (no classifications exist in enterprise) - 409: Classification already exists on this folder (use update action instead) - 403: Insufficient permissions to add classifications This API can also be called by including the enterprise ID in the URL explicitly, for example `/folders/:id//enterprise_12345/securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddClassificationToFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id",
    "Box__Security__Classification__Key"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represent a folder. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder of a Box account is always represented by the ID `0`. "
    },
    "Box__Security__Classification__Key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Box  Security  Classification  Key",
      "description": "The name of the classification to apply to this folder. This is a required field. To list the available classifications in an enterprise, use the classification API to retrieve the [classification template](e://get_metadata_templates_enterprise_securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo_schema) which lists all available classification keys. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddClassificationToFolder`"
}
```

**Output schema:**

## BOX_ADD_INITIAL_CLASSIFICATIONS
Initializes the classification template for an enterprise with an initial set of classification options. IMPORTANT: This action requires admin permissions and should only be called once per enterprise when no classifications exist. If classifications already exist, use the 'add_classification' action to add more options. Common classification examples: 'Confidential', 'Internal', 'Public', 'Restricted'. Returns 400 if the classification template already exists. Returns 403 if the user lacks admin permissions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddInitialClassificationsRequest",
  "required": [
    "scope",
    "templateKey",
    "displayName",
    "fields"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "enum": [
        "enterprise"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "description": "The scope for the classification template. Must be 'enterprise'."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ClassificationField",
        "required": [
          "type",
          "key",
          "displayName",
          "options"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "key": {
            "enum": [
              "Box__Security__Classification__Key"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Key",
            "description": "The key for the classification field. Must be 'Box__Security__Classification__Key'."
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "enum"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "description": "The type of field. Must always be 'enum' for classifications."
          },
          "hidden": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Hidden",
            "description": "Whether to hide the field from web and mobile interfaces."
          },
          "options": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "ClassificationOption",
              "required": [
                "key"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "key": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Key",
                  "description": "The unique key/name for this classification. This will be displayed in the Box UI and used when applying classifications to items."
                },
                "staticConfig": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "StaticConfig",
                  "properties": {
                    "classification": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "title": "ClassificationConfig",
                      "properties": {
                        "colorID": {
                          "type": "integer",
                          "title": "Color Id",
                          "description": "An identifier used to assign a color to a classification label. Values: 0=Yellow, 1=Orange, 2=Watermelon red, 3=Purple rain, 4=Light blue, 5=Dark blue, 6=Light green, 7=Gray."
                        },
                        "classificationDefinition": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "title": "Classification Definition",
                          "description": "A longer description of the classification that explains its usage."
                        }
                      },
                      "description": "Classification configuration for a classification option.",
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "Static configuration containing classification settings.",
                  "additionalProperties": false
                }
              },
              "description": "A classification option that can be applied to files and folders."
            },
            "title": "Options",
            "description": "The list of classification options available. Each option defines a classification level (e.g., 'Confidential', 'Public', 'Internal')."
          },
          "displayName": {
            "enum": [
              "Classification"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Display Name",
            "description": "The display name for the field. Must be 'Classification'."
          }
        },
        "description": "The classification field definition for the template."
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "The classification field definition. Must contain exactly one field of type 'enum' that holds all valid classification values."
    },
    "hidden": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hidden",
      "description": "Whether to hide the classification template from web and mobile interfaces."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "enum": [
        "Classification"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "description": "The display name. Must be 'Classification'."
```

## BOX_ADD_OR_UPDATE_USER_AVATAR
Adds or updates a user avatar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddOrUpdateUserAvatarRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "pic"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "pic": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "format": "binary",

        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "The avatar image file to upload. Requirements: file must be.jpg or.png format, maximum 1MB size, maximum 1024x1024 pixels.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The ID of the user."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddOrUpdateUserAvatar`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_SHARED_LINK_TO_FILE
Adds a shared link to a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddSharedLinkToFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Explicitly request the `shared_link` fields to be returned for this item. Defaults to 'shared_link' to return the shared link details in the response."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the file (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Set the password to `null` to remove it. Passwords must now be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for editing of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. This value can only be `true` is `can_download` is also `true`. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for previewing of files. This value is always `true`. For shared links on folders this also applies to any items in the folder. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__download": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Download",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for downloading of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddSharedLinkToFile`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_SHARED_LINK_TO_FOLDER
Adds a shared link to a folder, allowing it to be shared with others via a URL. This action creates or updates a shared link on a folder. The shared link can be configured with different access levels: - 'open': Anyone with the link can access - 'company': Only people within the company can access (paid accounts only) - 'collaborators': Only those invited to the folder can access To create a shared link with default enterprise settings, call with just folder_id and fields='shared_link'. To customize access, set shared_link_access parameter. Returns the folder object with the new shared_link information including the URL.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddSharedLinkToFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to return. To retrieve shared link details, use 'shared_link'. Example values: 'shared_link', 'shared_link,name,id'."
    },
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a folder. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder of a Box account is always represented by the ID `0`. Example: '12345678'."
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the folder (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Set the password to `null` to remove it. Passwords must now be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "This value can only be `false` for items with a `type` of `folder`."
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for previewing of files. This value is always `true`. For shared links on folders this also applies to any items in the folder. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__download": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Download",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for downloading of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddSharedLinkToFolder`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_SHARED_LINK_TO_WEB_LINK
Adds a shared link to a web link.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddSharedLinkToWebLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "web_link_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Set to 'shared_link' to return shared link details. Defaults to 'shared_link'."
    },
    "web_link_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Web Link Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the web link to add a shared link to."
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the file (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Set the password to `null` to remove it. Passwords must now be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "This value can only be `true` is `type` is `file`."
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for previewing of files. This value is always `true`. For shared links on folders this also applies to any items in the folder. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__download": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Download",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for downloading of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddSharedLinkToWebLink`"
}
```

## BOX_ADD_USER_TO_GROUP
Creates a group membership. Only users with admin-level permissions will be able to use this API.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddUserToGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "user__id",
    "group__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "admin",
        "member"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "RoleEnm0",
      "description": "The role of the user in the group. Can be 'admin' or 'member'. Admins have elevated permissions to manage the group. Members have standard access. Defaults to 'member' if not specified."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "user__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the user to add to the group. This is a required field."
    },
    "group__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the group to add the user to. This is a required field."
    },
    "configurable_permissions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Configurable Permissions",
      "description": "Custom configuration for the permissions an admin of a group will receive. This option has no effect on members with a role of 'member'. Setting these permissions overwrites the default access levels of an admin. Specifying a value of null for this object will disable all configurable permissions. Specifying permissions will set them accordingly, omitted permissions will be enabled by default. Example: {'can_run_reports': true, 'can_instant_login': false}.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AddUserToGroup`"
}
```

## BOX_APPEND_METADATA_TAXONOMY_LEVEL
Appends a new level to a metadata taxonomy structure. Use when adding hierarchical categories to organize metadata. If no levels exist, this creates the first level.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AppendMetadataTaxonomyLevelRequest",
  "required": [
    "namespace",
    "taxonomy_key",
    "displayName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "namespace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Namespace",
      "description": "The namespace of the metadata taxonomy. Use format 'enterprise_{enterprise_id}' for enterprise taxonomies (e.g., 'enterprise_123456')."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The description of the taxonomy level. Provides additional context about this level (e.g., 'French Republic', 'Second level taxonomy for testing')."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "description": "The display name of the taxonomy level to append. This is the label shown to users (e.g., 'France', 'Level 2')."
    },
    "taxonomy_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Taxonomy Key",
      "description": "The key of the metadata taxonomy to append the level to (e.g., 'geography', 'product_catalog')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AppendMetadataTaxonomyLevel`"
}
```

## BOX_APPLY_WATERMARK_TO_FILE
Applies or update a watermark on a file.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",

      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "watermark__imprint": {
      "enum": [
        "default"
      ],
```

## BOX_ASK_QUESTION
Ask questions about Box files using Box AI. Use this action to query one or more files with natural language questions. Box AI will analyze the file contents and provide an answer based on the information found in the files. Modes: - single_item_qa: Ask about a single file (items array must have exactly 1 element) - multiple_item_qa: Ask about multiple files (up to 25 files) Limitations: - Text documents: Up to 1MB per file, max 25 files - Images: 1024x1024px resolution, max 5 images/pages - Prompts: Max 10,000 characters Requires 'manage_ai' scope in the access token.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AskQuestionRequest",
  "required": [
    "mode",
    "prompt",
    "items"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "mode": {
      "enum": [
        "multiple_item_qa",
        "single_item_qa"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "description": "The query mode: 'single_item_qa' for questions about one file (items array must have exactly 1 element), or 'multiple_item_qa' for questions across multiple files (up to 25 files)."
    },
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AskQuestionitemsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "type"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier of the file or hub to query."
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "file",
              "hubs"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "description": "The type of item: 'file' for documents or 'hubs' for Box Hubs (hubs must be used as a single item)."
          },
          "content": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Content",
            "description": "Optional text content to include. If provided, this text will be used instead of extracting content from the file."
          }
        },
        "description": "Schema for items to be queried by Box AI."
      },
      "title": "Items",
      "description": "List of files to query. For 'single_item_qa' mode, provide exactly 1 item. For 'multiple_item_qa' mode, provide 1-25 items. Each item needs 'id' and 'type' fields."
    },
    "prompt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt",
      "description": "The question to ask about the file(s). Maximum 10,000 characters."
    },
    "ai_agent": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "AskQuestionAiAgentRequest",
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "default": "ai_agent_ask",
          "description": "The type of AI agent. Must be 'ai_agent_ask' for the ask endpoint."
        },
        "long_text": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Long Text",
          "description": "AI agent configuration for processing long text content.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "basic_text": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Basic Text",
          "description": "AI agent configuration for processing basic text content.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "long_text_multi": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Long Text Multi",
          "description": "AI agent configuration for processing multiple long text items.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "basic_text_multi": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Basic Text Multi",
          "description": "AI agent configuration for processing multiple basic text items.",
          "additionalProperties": true
        }
      },
      "description": "Schema for specifying a custom AI agent to handle the request.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "dialogue_history": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AskQuestiondialogueHistoryRequest",
        "properties": {
          "answer": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Answer",
            "description": "Box AI's previous answer to the prompt."
          },
          "prompt": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Prompt",
            "description": "A previous question that was asked to Box AI."
          },
          "created_at": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Created At",
            "format": "date-time",
            "description": "ISO 8601 timestamp of when the previous answer was generated (e.g., '2023-05-08T14:30:00Z')."
          }
        },
        "description": "Schema for previous conversation history to provide context to Box AI."
      },
      "title": "Dialogue History",
      "description": "Optional conversation history to provide context for follow-up questions."
    },
    "include_citations": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Citations",
      "description": "Set to true to include source citations in the response showing where the answer came from."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for asking questions about Box files using AI."
}
```

## BOX_ASSIGN_LEGAL_HOLD_POLICY
Assign a legal hold policy to a file, file version, folder, or user. Legal hold policies preserve content for litigation or compliance purposes by preventing the deletion of specified items. When assigned to a folder, the hold applies recursively to all contents. When assigned to a user, the hold applies to all content owned by that user. Note: This feature requires Box Enterprise or higher with legal hold capabilities enabled. The authenticated user must have admin privileges with 'manage_legal_holds' scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AssignLegalHoldPolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "policy_id",
    "assign__to__type",
    "assign__to__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "policy_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Policy Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the legal hold policy to assign. Obtain this ID from 'create_legal_hold_policy' or 'list_all_legal_hold_policies'."
    },
    "assign__to__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the item to assign the legal hold policy to. Must correspond to the type specified in assign_to_type."
    },
    "assign__to__type": {
      "enum": [
        "file",
        "file_version",
        "folder",
        "user",
        "ownership",
        "interactions"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Type",
      "description": "The type of item to assign the policy to. Options: 'file' (individual files), 'file_version' (specific file versions), 'folder' (applies recursively to all contents), 'user' (all content owned by a user), 'ownership' (ownership records), or 'interactions' (user interactions with content)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AssignLegalHoldPolicy`"
}
```

## BOX_ASSIGN_RETENTION_POLICY
Assigns a retention policy to an item in Box to enforce content retention. Use this action to apply a retention policy to: - An entire enterprise (assign_to_type='enterprise', no ID needed) - A specific folder (assign_to_type='folder', provide folder ID) - Items matching metadata criteria (assign_to_type='metadata_template', provide template ID) Prerequisites: - Box Governance license is required - Admin permissions with 'manage_data_retention' and 'enterprise_content' scopes - A retention policy must exist (use create_retention_policy first) Example usage for folder assignment: - policy_id: "173463" (from create_retention_policy or list_retention_policies) - assign_to_type: "folder" - assign_to_id: "6564564" (the folder ID)

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AssignRetentionPolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "policy_id",
    "assign__to__type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "policy_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Policy Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the retention policy to assign (e.g., '173463'). Get this from list_retention_policies or create_retention_policy."
    },
    "filter_fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FilterFieldItem",
        "properties": {
          "field": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Field",
            "description": "The metadata attribute key ID (e.g., 'a0f4ee4e-1dc1-4h90-a8a9-aef55fc681d4')."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "description": "The metadata attribute field value ID. Only enum and multiselect field types are supported (e.g., '0c27b756-0p87-4fe0-a43a-59fb661ccc4e')."
          }
        },
        "description": "Filter field for metadata-based retention policy assignments.\n\nUsed when assigning a retention policy to a metadata_template to filter\nwhich items the policy applies to based on metadata field values.",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Filter Fields",
      "description": "Optional metadata filters when assign_to_type is 'metadata_template'. Array of objects with 'field' (metadata attribute key ID) and 'value' (field value ID). Only enum and multiselect field types are supported. Currently limited to one filter object."
    },
    "assign__to__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the target item. Required for 'folder' (folder ID like '6564564') and 'metadata_template' (template ID). Omit or set to null when assign_to_type is 'enterprise'."
    },
    "assign__to__type": {
      "enum": [
        "enterprise",
        "folder",
        "metadata_template"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Type",
      "description": "The type of item to assign the policy to. Options: 'enterprise' (applies to all enterprise content), 'folder' (applies to specific folder by ID), 'metadata_template' (applies based on metadata criteria)."
    },
    "start_date_field": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date Field",
      "description": "The date field that determines when retention begins. For 'metadata_template' assignments, this can be a date field's metadata attribute key ID (e.g., 'upload_date'). Only applicable when assign_to_type is 'metadata_template'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for assigning a retention policy to an item.\n\nRetention policies can be assigned to:\n- 'enterprise': Applies to all content in the enterprise\n- 'folder': Applies to a specific folder and its contents\n- 'metadata_template': Applies to items matching specific metadata criteria",
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## BOX_ASSIGN_STORAGE_POLICY
Creates a storage policy assignment for an enterprise or user. Storage policies control where data is stored geographically (data residency). This action requires Box Zones or similar enterprise feature to be enabled. Use 'list_storage_policies' to get available policies before assignment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AssignStoragePolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "storage__policy__id",
    "assigned__to__type",
    "assigned__to__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "assigned__to__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assigned  To  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the entity to assign the policy to. If assigned_to_type is 'user', provide a user ID. If 'enterprise', provide the enterprise ID."
    },
    "assigned__to__type": {
      "enum": [
        "enterprise",
        "user"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assigned  To  Type",
      "description": "The type of entity to assign the storage policy to. Use 'user' to assign to a specific user, or 'enterprise' to set the default policy for the entire enterprise."
    },
    "storage__policy__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Storage  Policy  Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the storage policy to assign. Get available policies using the 'list_storage_policies' action."
    },
    "storage__policy__type": {
      "enum": [
        "storage_policy"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Storage  Policy  Type",
      "default": "storage_policy",
      "description": "The type of policy to assign. Must be 'storage_policy'. This field is fixed and agents typically don't need to specify it."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AssignStoragePolicy`"
}
```

## BOX_ASSIGN_TASK
Assigns a task to a user. A task can be assigned to more than one user by creating multiple assignments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AssignTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "task__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "task__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the task to assign. Required."
    },
    "task__type": {
      "enum": [
        "task"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task  Type",
      "default": "task",
      "description": "The type of the item being assigned. Must be 'task'."
    },
    "assign__to__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Id",
      "description": "The user ID of the person to assign the task to. Either this or `assign_to_login` must be provided, but not both."
    },
    "assign__to__login": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Assign  To  Login",
      "description": "The email address (login) of the user to assign the task to. Either this or `assign_to_id` must be provided, but not both."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AssignTask`"
}
```

## BOX_AUTHORIZE_USER
Authorize a user by sending them through the [Box](https://box.com) website and request their permission to act on their behalf. This is the first step when authenticating a user using OAuth 2.0. To request a user's authorization to use the Box APIs on their behalf you will need to send a user to the URL with this format.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AuthorizeUserRequest",
  "required": [
    "response_type",
    "client_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "description": "A space-separated list of application scopes to request (e.g., 'root_readwrite manage_users'). Defaults to all scopes configured for the application if not specified."
    },
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "description": "A custom string of your choice. Box will pass the same string to the redirect URL when authentication is complete. This parameter can be used to identify a user on redirect, as well as protect against hijacked sessions and other exploits. "
    },
    "client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Client Id",
      "description": "The Client ID of the application requesting to authenticate the user. Found in the Box developer console under your application's OAuth 2.0 Parameters section."
    },
    "redirect_uri": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Redirect Uri",
      "description": "The HTTPS URI to which Box redirects the browser after the user grants or denies permission. Must match one of the redirect URIs configured in your Box application. Required if multiple redirect URIs are configured; otherwise a 'redirect_uri_missing' error occurs."
    },
    "response_type": {
      "enum": [
        "code"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Response Type",
      "description": "The type of response to receive. Must be 'code' for the authorization code grant flow."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AuthorizeUser`"
}
```

## BOX_CANCEL_BOX_SIGN_REQUEST
Cancels a pending Box Sign request that has not yet been fully signed or declined. After cancellation, any outstanding signers will no longer be able to sign the document. Only the user who created the request (the requester) is able to cancel it. Note: A request cannot be cancelled if it was already declined, fully signed, or if the document is still in the converting state. Returns the cancelled sign request object with updated status set to 'cancelled'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelBoxSignRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "sign_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "sign_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sign Request Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Box Sign request to cancel. This ID is returned when creating a sign request or can be retrieved from the list of sign requests."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CancelBoxSignRequest`"
}
```

## BOX_COMMIT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Commits an upload session and creates a file from the uploaded chunks. This is the final step in a chunked upload workflow: 1. Create an upload session using 'create_upload_session' 2. Upload file parts using 'upload_part_of_file' 3. Commit the session using this action to finalize the file Requirements: - All parts must be uploaded before committing - The digest header must contain the SHA1 hash of the entire file (Base64 encoded) - Parts array must include part_id, offset, and size for each uploaded chunk Note: The API may return 202 if processing is not complete. In this case, check the retry_after field and retry after the specified number of seconds.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CommitUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "upload_session_id",
    "digest",
    "parts"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "parts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Parts",
      "description": "List of uploaded parts to commit. Each part must include: 'part_id' (string), 'offset' (integer byte position), 'size' (integer bytes). Optionally includes 'sha1' (string hash of the part). These values are returned by the upload part API."
    },
    "digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Digest",
      "description": "The Base64-encoded SHA1 hash of the entire file being uploaded. Format should be the raw Base64 string (e.g., 'fpRyg5eVQletdZqEKaFlqwBXJzM='). The 'sha=' prefix will be added automatically."
    },
    "if_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "description": "Optional. The last known ETag value of the upload session. If provided, the request fails with 412 if the session has changed."
    },
    "attributes": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attributes",
      "description": "Optional file attributes to set on the uploaded file, such as 'content_modified_at' (ISO 8601 timestamp). Example: {'content_modified_at': '2024-01-15T12:00:00Z'}.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "if_none_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If None Match",
      "description": "Optional. ETag value to check for changes. Request fails with 304 if item unchanged."
    },
    "upload_session_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Upload Session Id",
      "description": "The ID of the upload session to commit. This is returned when creating an upload session."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CommitUploadSession`"
}
```

## BOX_COPY_FILE
Creates a copy of a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "parent__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "An optional new name for the copied file. There are some restrictions to the file name. Names containing non-printable ASCII characters, forward and backward slashes (`/`, ``), and protected names like `.` and `..` are automatically sanitized by removing the non-allowed characters. "
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "version": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Version",
      "description": "An optional ID of the specific file version to copy."
    },
    "parent__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent  Id",
      "description": "The ID of folder to copy the file to. This parameter is required - the destination folder must be specified."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CopyFile`"
}
```

## BOX_COPY_FILE_REQUEST
Copies an existing file request to a new folder. File requests allow external users to upload files to a specific folder without needing a Box account. This action creates a copy of an existing file request and associates it with a different destination folder. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: File request IDs cannot be discovered via API - they can only be obtained from the Box web application. To find a file_request_id: 1. Navigate to Box web UI (https://app.box.com) 2. Go to the folder containing the file request 3. Open the file request settings 4. Copy the ID from the URL (e.g., https://*.app.box.com/filerequest/123 → ID is "123") Common use cases: - Creating file request templates that can be copied to multiple project folders - Automating file request creation for new cases/customers/projects - Duplicating file requests with different settings (title, description, etc.) When copying, you can optionally override settings from the source file request including title, description, status, and form requirements.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyFileRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_request_id",
    "folder"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "The title to use for the copied file request. This is displayed to uploaders on the file request form. If not provided, the title from the source file request is used."
    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Folder",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The unique identifier of the destination folder where the copied file request will be applied."
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "default": "folder",
          "description": "The type of the destination object. Must be 'folder'."
        }
      },
      "description": "The destination folder to associate with the copied file request. Must include the folder 'id' field.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "inactive"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "FileRequestStatus",
      "description": "Status of the file request."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The date after which the copied file request will no longer accept submissions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2030-12-31T23:59:59Z'). After this date, the status is automatically set to 'inactive'. If not provided, no expiration is set."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The description to use for the copied file request. This is displayed to uploaders on the file request form. If not provided, the description from the source file request is used."
    },
    "file_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Request Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the file request to copy. IMPORTANT: File request IDs can ONLY be obtained from the Box web application URL - there is no API to list file requests. Visit a file request in the Box web UI (e.g., https://*.app.box.com/filerequest/123) and copy the ID from the URL. In this example, the file_request_id would be '123'."
    },
    "is_email_required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Email Required",
      "description": "Whether uploaders must provide their email address when submitting files to the copied file request. If not provided, the setting from the source file request is used."
    },
    "is_description_required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Description Required",
      "description": "Whether uploaders must provide a description when submitting files to the copied file request. If not provided, the setting from the source file request is used."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CopyFileRequest`"
}
```

## BOX_COPY_FOLDER
Creates a copy of a folder within a destination folder. The original folder will not be changed.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id",
    "parent__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "An optional new name for the copied folder. There are some restrictions to the file name. Names containing non-printable ASCII characters, forward and backward slashes (`/`, ``), as well as names with trailing spaces are prohibited. Additionally, the names `.` and `..` are not allowed either. "
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the folder to copy. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder with the ID `0` can not be copied. "
    },
    "parent__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the destination folder where the copy will be placed. Use '0' to copy to the root folder (All Files). This is a required field."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CopyFolder`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_AI_AGENT
Creates a custom AI agent in Box AI Studio. At least one capability required: ask (Q&A), text_gen (content generation), or extract (metadata extraction). Requirements: Box Enterprise Advanced account, Box AI Studio enabled, "Manage AI" scope in Developer Console. Access options: 'enabled' (all users), 'disabled' (none), 'enabled_for_selected_users' (specified in allowed_entities). Example: Set name + ask__type='ai_agent_ask' + ask__access__state='enabled' + ask__description to create Q&A agent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAiAgentRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "The display name of the AI Agent visible to users in the Box interface."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "ai_agent"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "ai_agent",
      "description": "The type of agent. Must be 'ai_agent'."
    },
    "ask__type": {
      "enum": [
        "ai_agent_ask"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm1",
      "description": "Type identifier for ask capability. Must be 'ai_agent_ask' when enabling this capability."
    },
    "access_state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Access State",
      "default": "enabled",
      "description": "Access control for the agent. Options: 'enabled' (all enterprise users), 'disabled' (no access), 'enabled_for_selected_users' (only specified users/groups in allowed_entities)."
    },
    "extract__type": {
      "enum": [
        "ai_agent_extract"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm3",
      "description": "Type identifier for extract capability. Must be 'ai_agent_extract' when enabling this capability."
    },
    "icon_reference": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Icon Reference",
      "description": "Avatar icon URL for the agent. Format: https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/<file_name>. Available icons: logo_boxAi, logo_stamp, logo_legal, logo_finance, logo_config, logo_handshake, logo_analytics, logo_classification (both .png and .svg supported). Example: https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/logo_analytics.svg"
    },
    "text__gen__type": {
      "enum": [
        "ai_agent_text_gen"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm2",
      "description": "Type identifier for text generation capability. Must be 'ai_agent_text_gen' when enabling this capability."
    },
    "allowed_entities": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Allowed Entities",
      "description": "Users/groups with access when access_state='enabled_for_selected_users'. Format: [{'type': 'user'|'group', 'id': '<entity_id>'}]"
    },
    "ask__description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ask  Description",
      "description": "User-facing description of what questions this agent can answer."
    },
    "ask__access__state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ask  Access  State",
      "description": "Enable state for ask capability. Options: 'enabled', 'disabled'."
    },
    "extract__description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extract  Description",
      "description": "User-facing description of what metadata/data this agent can extract from documents."
    },
    "extract__access__state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extract  Access  State",
      "description": "Enable state for extract capability. Options: 'enabled', 'disabled'."
    },
    "text__gen__description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text  Gen  Description",
      "description": "User-facing description of what content this agent can generate."
    },
    "text__gen__access__state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text  Gen  Access  State",
      "description": "Enable state for text generation capability. Options: 'enabled', 'disabled'."
    },
    "ask__custom__instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Ask  Custom  Instructions",
      "description": "System prompt/instructions defining agent behavior, tone, and constraints for answering questions."
    },
    "ask__suggested__questions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Ask  Suggested  Questions",
      "description": "Up to 4 suggested questions shown to users. Example: ['What is in this file?', 'Summarize the key points']"
    },
    "extract__custom__instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extract  Custom  Instructions",
      "description": "System prompt/instructions defining extraction rules, field mappings, and output formatting."
    },
    "text__gen__custom__instructions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text  Gen  Custom  Instructions",
      "description": "System prompt/instructions defining writing style, format, and content generation guidelines."
    },
    "text__gen__suggested__questions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Text  Gen  Suggested  Questions",
      "description": "Up to 4 suggested prompts shown to users. Example: ['Write a summary', 'Create a report']"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateAiAgent`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_BOX_SIGN_REQUEST
Creates a Box Sign request to send documents for electronic signing. Prepares documents and sends signature requests to signers via email. Signers do not need Box accounts. Supports up to 10 files, 35 signers, sequential signing order, templates, and custom redirect URLs. Requires Box Sign feature enabled and sign_requests.readwrite scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBoxSignRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "source_files",
    "signers"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "Name of the signature request. Used for identification purposes."
    },
    "signers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Signer",
        "required": [
          "email"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "enum": [
              "signer",
              "approver",
              "final_copy_reader"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "SignerRole",
            "default": "signer",
            "description": "Role of the signer in the signature request"
          },
          "email": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Email",
            "description": "Email address of the signer. Signers do not need a Box account to sign."
          },
          "order": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Order",
            "description": "Signing order (1, 2, 3...). Lower numbers sign first. Same order values receive request simultaneously."
          },
          "is_in_person": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Is In Person",
            "description": "If true, the signer will sign in-person rather than via email."
          },

            "type": "string",
            "title": "Redirect Url",
            "description": "URL to redirect this signer to after signing. Overrides global redirect_url for this signer."
          },
          "login_required": {
            "type": "boolean",
            "title": "Login Required",
            "description": "If true, the signer must log in to a Box account before signing."
          },
          "signer_group_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Signer Group Id",
            "description": "Optional group ID to group signers. Signers in the same group can fulfill the signature requirement interchangeably."
          },
          "declined_redirect_url": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Declined Redirect Url",
            "description": "URL to redirect this signer to if they decline. Overrides global declined_redirect_url for this signer."
          },

            "type": "string",
            "title": "Embed Url External User Id",
            "description": "External user ID for embedded signing URLs. Required when generating embedded signing experiences."
          }
        },
        "description": "Information about a signer for the signature request. Maximum 35 signers allowed per request."
      },
      "title": "Signers",
      "description": "List of signers for the signature request. At least one signer required, maximum 35 signers."
    },

      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Days Valid",

    },
    "external_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External Id",
      "description": "External reference ID for tracking the signature request in your system."
    },
    "template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Id",

    },

      "title": "Prefill Tags",
```

## BOX_CREATE_BOX_SKILL_CARDS_ON_FILE
Applies one or more Box Skills metadata cards to a file. NOTE: This action creates NEW Box Skill cards on a file. If Box Skill cards already exist on the file, this action will fail with a 409 Conflict error. In that case: - Use 'remove_box_skill_cards_from_file' to delete existing cards first, then create new ones, OR - Use 'update_all_box_skill_cards_on_file' to overwrite all existing cards

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBoxSkillCardsOnFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "cards"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "cards": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Cards",
      "description": "A list of Box Skill cards to apply to this file. Each card must include: 'type' (always 'skill_card'), 'skill_card_type' (one of: 'keyword', 'transcript', 'timeline', 'status'), 'skill' (object with 'type': 'service' and 'id'), 'invocation' (object with 'type': 'skill_invocation' and 'id'), and 'skill_card_title' (object with 'code' and 'message'). Additional fields depend on card type: keyword cards need 'entries' array with 'text' fields; transcript cards need 'entries' with 'text' and 'appears' (array of start/end timestamps) plus optional 'duration'; timeline cards need 'entries' with 'text', 'appears', and optional 'image_url' plus 'duration'; status cards need 'status' object with 'code' and 'message'."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. Note: This file must NOT have existing Box Skill cards metadata, otherwise a 409 Conflict error will occur."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateBoxSkillCardsOnFile`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "SkillCard": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SkillCard",
      "required": [
        "type",

        "skill_card_title",
        "skill",
        "invocation"
      ],

        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "skill_card",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "Always 'skill_card' for skill card objects."
        },
        "skill": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Skill",
          "required": [
            "type",
            "id"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "id": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Id",
              "description": "A custom identifier for the service that applied the skill."
            },
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "service",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "Always 'service' for skill objects."
            }
          },
          "description": "The service that applied this skill card."
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Status",
          "required": [
            "code"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "code": {
```

## BOX_CREATE_COLLAB_EXEMPTION
Exempts a specific user from the enterprise's collaboration domain restrictions. This allows the specified user to collaborate with external parties from any domain, bypassing the enterprise's allowed collaboration domain list. PREREQUISITES: - The enterprise MUST have at least one allowed collaboration domain configured. Use 'Add domain to list of allowed collaboration domains' first if needed. - The user must not already have an exemption (returns 409 Conflict if exists). - Requires enterprise admin privileges with 'manage_users' scope. COMMON ERRORS: - 409 Conflict: User already exempt OR no whitelisted domains exist for enterprise. - 403 Forbidden: Insufficient permissions to manage user exemptions. - 404 Not Found: The specified user ID does not exist.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCollabExemptionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the Box user to exempt from collaboration domain restrictions. This allows the specified user to collaborate with external parties regardless of the enterprise's allowed domain list. Example: '23522323'"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateCollabExemption`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_COLLABORATION
Adds a collaboration for a single user or a single group to a file or folder. Collaborations can be created using email address, user IDs, or a group IDs. If a collaboration is being created with a group, access to this endpoint is dependent on the group's ability to be invited. If collaboration is in `pending` status, the following fields are redacted: - `login` and `name` are hidden if a collaboration was created using `user_id`, - `name` is hidden if a collaboration was created using `login`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCollaborationRequest",
  "required": [
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "co-owner",
        "editor",
        "previewer",
        "previewer uploader",
        "uploader",
        "viewer",
        "viewer uploader"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "description": "The level of access granted. Valid values are: 'editor' (full read/write access), 'viewer' (read-only access), 'previewer' (preview-only), 'uploader' (upload-only), 'previewer uploader' (preview and upload), 'viewer uploader' (view and upload), or 'co-owner' (full access including sharing). "
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notify",
      "description": "Determines if users should receive email notification for the action performed. "
    },
    "item__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item  Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the file or folder to grant access to. Required for creating a new collaboration. You can find this ID in the Box web interface URL or from other API responses. "
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Set the expiration date for the collaboration. At this date, the collaboration will be automatically removed from the item. This feature will only work if the **Automatically remove invited collaborators: Allow folder owners to extend the expiry date** setting has been enabled in the **Enterprise Settings** of the **Admin Console**. When the setting is not enabled, collaborations can not have an expiry date and a value for this field will be result in an error. "
    },
    "item__type": {
      "enum": [
        "file",
        "folder"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm0",
      "description": "The type of the item that this collaboration will be granted access to. Must be either 'file' or 'folder'. Required for creating a new collaboration. "
    },
    "can_view_path": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Can View Path",
      "description": "Determines if the invited users can see the entire parent path to the associated folder. The user will not gain privileges in any parent folder and therefore can not see content the user is not collaborated on. Be aware that this meaningfully increases the time required to load the invitee\"s **All Files** page. We recommend you limit the number of collaborations with `can_view_path` enabled to 1,000 per user. Only owner or co-owners can invite collaborators with a `can_view_path` of `true`. `can_view_path` can only be used for folder collaborations. "
    },
    "is_access_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Access Only",
      "description": "If set to `true`, collaborators have access to shared items, but such items won\"t be visible in the All Files list. Additionally, collaborators won\"t see the the path to the root folder for the shared item. "
    },
    "accessible__by__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Accessible  By  Id",
      "description": "The Box user ID or group ID to invite. Either this field or 'accessible_by_login' must be provided (not both). Use this when you know the exact Box user/group ID. "
    },
    "accessible__by__type": {
      "enum": [
        "group",
        "user"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm1",
      "description": "The type of collaborator to invite. Must be either 'user' or 'group'. Required. Use 'user' when inviting an individual (by email or user ID), or 'group' when sharing with a Box group. "
    },
    "accessible__by__login": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Accessible  By  Login",
      "description": "The email address of the user to invite as a collaborator. Either this field or 'accessible_by_id' must be provided (not both). Use this for user invitations when you have the email address but not the Box user ID. Not applicable for groups. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateCollaboration`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_COMMENT
Adds a comment by the user to a specific file, or as a reply to an other comment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCommentRequest",
  "required": [
    "item__id",
    "item__type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "description": "The text of the comment. Required unless `tagged_message` is provided. To mention a user, use `tagged_message` instead. "
    },
    "item__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the item to attach the comment to. This can be a file ID or a comment ID (when replying to a comment). "
    },
    "item__type": {
      "enum": [
        "comment",
        "file"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item  Type",
      "description": "The type of item this comment will be placed on. Use 'file' to comment on a file, or 'comment' to reply to an existing comment. "
    },
    "tagged_message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tagged Message",
      "description": "The text of the comment with user mentions. Use the format `@[user_id:name]` to mention a user, which sends them an email notification. The `user_id` is the target user's ID, and `name` is a display phrase that links to the user's profile in Box UI. Either `message` or `tagged_message` must be provided, but not both. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateComment`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_FOLDER_LOCK
Creates a folder lock on a folder, preventing it from being moved and/or deleted. You must be authenticated as the owner or co-owner of the folder to use this endpoint.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateFolderLockRequest",
  "properties": {
    "folder__id": {
      "type": "string",

      "description": "The ID of the folder."
    },
    "folder__type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder  Type",
      "description": "The content type the lock is being applied to. Only `folder` is supported. "
    },
    "locked__operations__move": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Locked  Operations  Move",
      "description": "Whether moving the folder should be locked."
    },
    "locked__operations__delete": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Locked  Operations  Delete",
      "description": "Whether deleting the folder should be locked."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateFolderLock`"
}
```

## BOX_CREATE_GROUP
Creates a new group of users in an enterprise. Only users with admin permissions can create new groups.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",

      "description": "Keeps track of which external source this group is coming, for example `Active Directory`, or `Okta`. Setting this will also prevent Box admins from editing the group name and its members directly via the Box web application. This is desirable for one-way syncing of groups. "

      "title": "Description",

When set to `admins_and_members` all the admins listed above and group members can invite the group. When set to `all_managed_users` all managed users in the enterprise can invite the group. "
    },
    "external_sync_identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External Sync Identifier",
      "description": "An arbitrary identifier that can be used by external group sync tools to link this Box Group to an external group. Example values of this field could be an **Active Directory Object ID** or a **Google Group ID**. We recommend you use of this field in order to avoid issues when group names are updated in either Box or external systems. "
    },
    "member_viewability_level": {
      "enum": [
        "admins_and_members",
        "admins_only",
        "all_managed_users"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MemberViewabilityLevelEnm0",
      "description": "Specifies who can see the members of the group. * `admins_only` - the enterprise admin, co-admins, group\"s   group admin * `admins_and_members` - all admins and group members * `all_managed_users` - all managed users in the   enterprise "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateGroup`"
}
```
