## BOX_START_WORKFLOW
Starts a Box Relay workflow with trigger type `WORKFLOW_MANUAL_START`. Prerequisites: - Your application must have the 'Manage Box Relay' scope enabled in the Box Developer Console. - Use the 'List Workflows' endpoint to get the workflow_id, flow.id, and folder.id. - All files specified must exist in the workflow's configured folder. Workflow: 1. Call 'List Workflows' with the folder_id to get available workflows. 2. From the response, extract: workflow.id, flows[].id, and any outcome IDs if needed. 3. Call this endpoint with the extracted IDs and the file IDs to process. Returns HTTP 204 No Content on success.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "StartWorkflowRequest",
  "required": [
    "workflow_id",
    "files"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "workflow_parameters"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "default": "workflow_parameters",
      "description": "The type of the parameters object. Must be 'workflow_parameters'."
    },
    "files": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "StartsWorkflowBasedOnRequestBodyfilesRequest",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier of the file. The file must exist in the workflow's configured folder."
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "file"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "default": "file",
            "description": "The type of the object. Must be 'file'."
          }
        },
        "description": "File object to include in the workflow. All files must be in the workflow's configured folder."
      },
      "title": "Files",
      "description": "Array of file objects to process with the workflow. Maximum 20 files per request. All files must be located in the workflow's configured folder."
    },
    "flow__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Flow  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the flow to trigger. Obtain this from the workflow's 'flows' array in the List Workflows response."
    },
    "outcomes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "StartsWorkflowBasedOnRequestBodyoutcomesRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier of the outcome. Obtain this from the workflow's 'flows' array in the List Workflows response."
          }
        },
        "description": "Configurable outcome for the workflow. Required if the workflow has runtime-configurable outcomes.",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Outcomes",
      "description": "Optional array of configurable outcomes for the workflow. Required if the workflow has runtime-configurable outcomes defined."
    },
    "flow__type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Flow  Type",
      "default": "flow",
      "description": "The type of the flow object. Must be 'flow'."
    },
    "folder__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder  Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the folder where the workflow is configured. This must match the folder associated with the workflow."
    },
    "workflow_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Workflow Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the workflow to start. Obtain this from the List Workflows endpoint."
    },
    "folder__type": {
      "enum": [
        "folder"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder  Type",
      "default": "folder",
      "description": "The type of the folder object. Must be 'folder'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for starting a Box Relay workflow manually."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "$defs": {

    }
```

## BOX_TERMINATE_USER_GROUP_SESSIONS
Terminates all active sessions for users belonging to the specified Box enterprise groups. This action validates the roles and permissions of each group, then creates asynchronous background jobs to terminate sessions for all users in those groups. The operation is processed asynchronously - check admin events to monitor job status. Requires admin privileges. Use this to enforce security policies or respond to security incidents affecting entire groups.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "TerminateUserGroupSessionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Group Ids",
      "description": "A list of Box enterprise group IDs whose members' sessions should be terminated. At least one group ID must be provided. Each group ID is a numeric string (e.g., '25521921228'). Use the list_groups_for_enterprise action to retrieve valid group IDs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `TerminateUserGroupSessions`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "TerminateUserGroupSessionsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TerminateUserGroupSessionsResponse",
      "required": [
        "message"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "description": "Status message indicating the termination job has been created successfully. Instructs to check admin events for job status. Example: 'Request is successful, please check the admin events for the status of the job'"
        }
```

## BOX_TERMINATE_USER_SESSIONS
Creates asynchronous jobs to terminate active Box sessions for specified users. Use this when a user account may be compromised, a device is lost/stolen, or you need to force users to re-authenticate. This logs out users from all active sessions including web, desktop, and mobile apps. Both user_ids and user_logins parameters are required. Returns HTTP 202 on success with an async job created.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "TerminateUserSessionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_ids",
    "user_logins"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "User Ids",
      "description": "A list of Box user IDs whose sessions should be terminated. Example: ['48351505451', '48351542393']. Both user_ids and user_logins are required."
    },
    "user_logins": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "User Logins",
      "description": "A list of user login email addresses corresponding to the user_ids. Example: ['user@example.com', 'user2@example.com']. Both user_ids and user_logins are required."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `TerminateUserSessions`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "description": "A success message indicating the session termination job was created. Example: 'Request is successful, please check the admin events for the status of the job'"
        }
      },
      "description": "Response schema for `TerminateUserSessions`"
    }
  },

        }
      },
```

## BOX_TRANSFER_OWNED_FOLDERS
Transfers all files and folders owned by one user to another user's account in Box. This creates a new folder in the destination user's root directory containing all the source user's content. The operation is commonly used for employee offboarding, role transitions, or account consolidation. Important: This operation is irreversible and requires enterprise admin permissions. All existing shared links and folder-level collaborations are preserved during transfer.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "TransferOwnedFoldersRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "owned__by__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "List of field names to include in the response (e.g., ['id', 'name', 'owned_by']). When specified, only the requested fields plus mini representation fields are returned. If not specified, the standard folder object with all default fields is returned."
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notify",
      "description": "Determines if users should receive email notification for the action performed. "
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The ID of the source user whose content will be transferred. All files and folders owned by this user will be moved to the destination user's account. Use BOX_LIST_ENTERPRISE_USERS to find valid user IDs. Requires enterprise admin permissions."
    },
    "owned__by__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Owned  By  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the destination user who will receive ownership of the transferred content. A new folder will be created in this user's root directory containing all the source user's files and folders. Use BOX_LIST_ENTERPRISE_USERS to find valid user IDs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `TransferOwnedFolders`"
}
```

## BOX_TRIM_METADATA_TAXONOMY_LEVELS
Deletes the last level from a metadata taxonomy by trimming it. Use when you need to remove the deepest hierarchical level from a taxonomy structure.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "TrimMetadataTaxonomyLevelsRequest",
  "required": [
    "namespace",
    "taxonomy_key"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "namespace": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Namespace",
      "examples": [
        "enterprise_123456"
      ],
      "description": "The namespace of the metadata taxonomy. For enterprise taxonomies, this is typically in the format 'enterprise_123456' where 123456 is your enterprise ID. You can find this by listing metadata templates or inspecting existing metadata instances."
    },
    "taxonomy_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Taxonomy Key",
      "examples": [
        "geography",
        "product_categories"
      ],
      "description": "The key of the metadata taxonomy to trim. This identifies the specific taxonomy whose last level will be removed. The taxonomy key is defined when the taxonomy is created and can be found by listing metadata templates."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `TrimMetadataTaxonomyLevels`"
}
```

## BOX_UNASSIGN_LEGAL_HOLD_POLICY
Remove a legal hold policy assignment from an item (user, folder, file, or file version). This endpoint unassigns a legal hold policy by deleting the assignment record. When successful, the API returns a 202 Accepted response with an empty body. IMPORTANT: This is an asynchronous operation - the legal hold is not fully removed when the response returns. The removal process continues in the background. To get the assignment ID: - Use 'assign_legal_hold_policy' and capture the returned 'id' field - Or use 'list_legal_hold_policy_assignments' to find existing assignment IDs Prerequisites: - Box Enterprise account with Box Governance add-on - OAuth scope: 'manage_legal_hold' - Admin-level permissions on the Box account Use case: Remove legal holds when litigation is resolved or content no longer needs to be preserved for compliance purposes.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UnassignLegalHoldPolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "legal_hold_policy_assignment_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "legal_hold_policy_assignment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Legal Hold Policy Assignment Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the legal hold policy assignment to remove. This ID can be obtained from 'assign_legal_hold_policy' (which returns it upon creation) or from 'list_legal_hold_policy_assignments'. Example: '753465'"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UnassignLegalHoldPolicy`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UnassignLegalHoldPolicyResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UnassignLegalHoldPolicyResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response schema for `UnassignLegalHoldPolicy`.\n\nReturns a 202 Accepted status with an empty response body when the assignment\ndeletion is successfully initiated. Since this is an asynchronous operation,\nthe actual removal of the legal hold is not complete when the response returns.\n\nThe API returns a blank response (null body) to indicate the deletion request\nwas accepted for asynchronous processing."
    }
  },
  "title": "UnassignLegalHoldPolicyResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_AI_AGENT
Updates an existing custom AI agent in Box AI Studio. You can modify the agent's name, access settings, icon, and capability configurations (ask, text_gen, extract). **Requirements:** - Box Enterprise Advanced account with Box AI Studio enabled - "Manage AI" scope must be enabled in the Box Developer Console **Usage Notes:** - The `type` field must always be set to 'ai_agent' - Only custom agents (origin='CUSTOM') can be updated; Box default agents cannot be modified - When updating capabilities, provide all required fields (type, access_state, description) - Use `enabled_for_selected_users` access_state with `allowed_entities` to restrict access **Example:** To update an agent's name and enable the ask capability: agent_id="1234567890", name="Updated Agent", access_state="enabled", ask_type="ai_agent_ask", ask_access_state="enabled", ask_description="Ask questions about documents"

**Input schema:**
```json

    "name",
    "access_state"

        "ai_agent"

      "title": "Type",
      "default": "ai_agent",

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Agent Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the AI Agent to update. This is a numeric string ID returned when creating an agent or listing agents."

      "enum": [
        "ai_agent_ask"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm1",
      "description": "Type for the 'ask' capability. Must be 'ai_agent_ask' when configuring this capability."
    },
    "access_state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Access State",

    "extract__type": {
      "enum": [
        "ai_agent_extract"

    },
    "icon_reference": {

Must use format: https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/<file_name> Valid file names (supports both .png and .svg): logo_boxAi, logo_stamp, logo_legal, logo_finance, logo_config, logo_handshake, logo_analytics, logo_classification. Example: https://cdn01.boxcdn.net/app-assets/aistudio/avatars/logo_analytics.svg"

}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_ALL_BOX_SKILL_CARDS_ON_FILE
An alternative method to overwrite and update all Box Skill metadata cards on a file. IMPORTANT: This endpoint is designed for Box Skills applications. The skill_id parameter must be a valid Box-assigned skill invocation ID that is received in the webhook payload when Box triggers a skill on a file. This ID is NOT a user-created identifier. Use Cases: - Update skill card metadata after processing a file with a custom Box Skill - Report processing status (success, failure, in-progress) back to Box - Overwrite existing skill cards with new results from ML/AI processing For creating skill cards on files without a skill invocation ID, use: - 'create_box_skill_cards_on_file' to add new skill cards - 'list_box_skill_cards_on_file' to view existing skill cards - 'remove_box_skill_cards_from_file' to delete skill cards

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateAllBoxSkillCardsOnFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "skill_id",
    "status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "invoked",
        "permanent_failure",
        "processing",
        "success",
        "transient_failure"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "description": "Defines the status of this skill invocation. Set to 'success' when applying completed skill cards. Use 'processing' to indicate ongoing processing, 'invoked' when the skill has been triggered, 'transient_failure' for recoverable errors, or 'permanent_failure' for unrecoverable errors."
    },
    "file__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the file to assign the skill cards to. Required when specifying file. The file ID can be found in the Box URL: https://*.app.box.com/files/{file_id}"
    },
    "skill_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Skill Id",
      "description": "The Box-assigned skill invocation ID. This ID is received in the webhook payload sent by Box when a skill is triggered on a file. It is NOT the same as the skill service ID or invocation ID you specify in skill cards. Example format: a numeric string like '33243242'."
    },
    "file__type": {
      "enum": [
        "file"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm0",
      "description": "The type of the item, always 'file'. Required when specifying file."
    },
    "usage__unit": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Usage  Unit",
      "description": "The unit of usage for the skill invocation, typically 'file'. This is usually omitted unless tracking skill usage metrics."
    },
    "usage__value": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Usage  Value",
      "description": "The value of usage for the skill invocation, typically 1. This is usually omitted unless tracking skill usage metrics."
    },
    "metadata__cards": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Metadata  Cards",
      "description": "A list of Box Skill cards to apply to this file. These cards will overwrite any existing skill cards on the file. Each card must include: 'type' (always 'skill_card'), 'skill_card_type' (one of: 'keyword', 'transcript', 'timeline', 'status'), 'skill' (object with 'type': 'service' and 'id'), 'invocation' (object with 'type': 'skill_invocation' and 'id'), and 'skill_card_title' (object with 'code' and 'message'). Additional fields depend on card type."
    },
    "file__version__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File  Version  Id",
      "description": "The ID of the specific file version to assign the cards to. Optional - if not provided, the cards are applied to the current file version."
    },
    "file__version__type": {
      "enum": [
        "file_version"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeEnm1",
      "description": "The type of the file version, always 'file_version'. Only required when targeting a specific file version instead of the current version."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateAllBoxSkillCardsOnFile`"
}
```

**Output schema:**

## BOX_UPDATE_BARRIER_SEGMENT
Updates a shield information barrier segment's name and/or description. Shield Information Barrier segments represent organizational divisions (e.g., 'Investment Banking', 'Research', 'Trading') that need to be isolated from each other for regulatory compliance or information security purposes. Use this action to modify a segment's identifying information after creation. At least one of 'name' or 'description' should be provided. Requirements: - Box Shield license is required to use this feature - The segment must exist (obtained from list_shield_information_barrier_segments) - Admin permissions are required to update segments Returns 404 if segment not found, 409 if name conflicts with an existing segment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBarrierSegmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "shield_information_barrier_segment_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "pattern": "\\S+",
      "description": "The new name for the shield information barrier segment (e.g., 'Investment Banking', 'Research Division'). Must be unique within the barrier. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The new description for the shield information barrier segment explaining its purpose (e.g., 'Corporate division that handles M&A advisory services'). Can be set to null to clear the existing description."
    },
    "shield_information_barrier_segment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shield Information Barrier Segment Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the shield information barrier segment to update. Obtain this ID from list_shield_information_barrier_segments or create_shield_information_barrier_segment actions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateBarrierSegment`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_BOX_SKILL_CARDS_ON_FILE
Updates one or more Box Skills metadata cards on a file using JSON-Patch format. This action allows you to selectively update specific skill cards by their index position without affecting other cards. Use the 'replace' operation to modify existing cards at specified positions (e.g., /cards/0 for the first card). NOTE: This updates existing cards in place. To view existing cards first, use 'list_box_skill_cards_on_file'. To add new cards, use 'create_box_skill_cards_on_file'. To remove all cards, use 'remove_box_skill_cards_from_file'.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBoxSkillCardsOnFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "operations"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`."
    },
    "operations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UpdateBoxSkillCardsOnFileOperationRequest",
        "required": [
          "op",
          "path",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "op": {
            "enum": [
              "replace"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Op",
            "description": "The JSON-Patch operation type. Always 'replace' for updating Box Skill cards."
          },
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "description": "The JSON Path that represents the card to replace. Format: '/cards/{index}' where {index} is the zero-indexed position of the card in the list. Example: '/cards/0' replaces the first card, '/cards/1' replaces the second."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Value",
            "description": "The Box Skill card object to replace at the specified path. Must include: 'type' (always 'skill_card'), 'skill_card_type' (one of: 'keyword', 'transcript', 'timeline', 'status'), 'skill' (object with 'type': 'service' and 'id'), 'invocation' (object with 'type': 'skill_invocation' and 'id'), and 'skill_card_title' (object with 'code' and 'message'). Additional fields depend on card type: keyword/transcript/timeline cards need 'entries' array; status cards need 'status' object.",
            "additionalProperties": true
          }
        },
        "description": "A single JSON-Patch operation to replace a Box Skill card"
      },
      "title": "Operations",
      "description": "A JSON-Patch array of operations to update Box Skill cards. Each operation should have 'op' set to 'replace', 'path' pointing to the card index (e.g., '/cards/0'), and 'value' containing the complete updated skill card object."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateBoxSkillCardsOnFile`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_COLLABORATION
Updates a collaboration. Can be used to change the owner of an item, or to accept collaboration invites.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCollaborationRequest",
  "required": [
    "collaboration_id",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "co-owner",
        "editor",
        "owner",
        "previewer",
        "previewer uploader",
        "uploader",
        "viewer",
        "viewer uploader"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "description": "The level of access granted."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "accepted",
        "pending",
        "rejected"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "StatusEnm0",
      "description": "<!--alex ignore reject--> Set the status of a `pending` collaboration invitation, effectively accepting, or rejecting the invite. "
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Update the expiration date for the collaboration. At this date, the collaboration will be automatically removed from the item. This feature will only work if the **Automatically remove invited collaborators: Allow folder owners to extend the expiry date** setting has been enabled in the **Enterprise Settings** of the **Admin Console**. When the setting is not enabled, collaborations can not have an expiry date and a value for this field will be result in an error. Additionally, a collaboration can only be given an expiration if it was created after the **Automatically remove invited collaborator** setting was enabled. "
    },
    "can_view_path": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Can View Path",
      "description": "Determines if the invited users can see the entire parent path to the associated folder. The user will not gain privileges in any parent folder and therefore can not see content the user is not collaborated on. Be aware that this meaningfully increases the time required to load the invitee\"s **All Files** page. We recommend you limit the number of collaborations with `can_view_path` enabled to 1,000 per user. Only owner or co-owners can invite collaborators with a `can_view_path` of `true`. `can_view_path` can only be used for folder collaborations. "
    },
    "collaboration_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Collaboration Id",
      "description": "The ID of the collaboration"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateCollaboration`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_COMMENT
Update the message of a comment.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCommentRequest",
  "required": [
    "comment_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. Available fields include: id, type, is_reply_comment, message, tagged_message, created_by, created_at, modified_at, item. If not specified, a standard set of fields is returned. Specifying this parameter returns only the requested fields plus the mini representation fields."
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "description": "The new text content for the comment. This replaces the existing message. Supports plain text and Unicode characters including emojis."
    },
    "comment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the comment to update. You can obtain this ID from the 'list_file_comments' action or from the response when creating a comment with 'create_comment'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateComment`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_FILE
Updates a file. This can be used to rename or move a file, create a shared link, or lock a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "An optional different name for the file. This can be used to rename the file. "
    },
    "tags": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Tags",
      "description": "The tags for this item. These tags are shown in the Box web app and mobile apps next to an item. To add or remove a tag, retrieve the item\"s current tags, modify them, and then update this field. There is a limit of 100 tags per item, and 10,000 unique tags per enterprise. "
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "parent__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent  Id",
      "description": "The ID of a folder to move the file to. This can be used to move a file to a different location. For example, to move a file to the root folder, set this to '0'. Note: When passing parameters as JSON, use 'parent__id' (with double underscores)."
    },
    "collections": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UpdateFilecollectionsRequest",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier for this object"
          },
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "description": "The type for this object"
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for `UpdateFilecollections`"
      },
      "title": "Collections",
      "description": "An array of collections to make this file a member of. Currently we only support the `favorites` collection. To get the ID for a collection, use the [List all collections][1] endpoint. Passing an empty array `[]` or `null` will remove the file from all collections. [1]: e://get-collections "
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The description for a file. This can be seen in the right-hand sidebar panel when viewing a file in the Box web app. Additionally, this index is used in the search index of the file, allowing users to find the file by the content in the description. "
    },
    "lock__access": {
      "enum": [
        "lock"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "Set to 'lock' to create a lock on the file, preventing others from modifying it. To remove a lock, use an API call with lock set to null in the raw request. The only accepted value is 'lock'. Note: When passing parameters as JSON, use 'lock__access' (with double underscores)."
    },
    "disposition_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Disposition At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The retention expiration timestamp for the given file. This date cannot be shortened once set on a file. "
    },
    "lock__expires__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lock  Expires  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "Defines the time at which the lock expires. Note: When passing parameters as JSON, use 'lock__expires__at' (with double underscores)."
    },
    "permissions__can__download": {
      "enum": [
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "CanDownloadEnm0",
      "description": "Defines who is allowed to download this file. The possible values are either `open` for everyone or `company` for the other members of the user\"s enterprise. This setting overrides the download permissions that are normally part of the `role` of a collaboration. When set to `company`, this essentially removes the download option for external users with `viewer` or `editor` a roles. Note: When passing parameters as JSON, use 'permissions__can__download' (with double underscores)."
    },
    "lock__is__download__prevented": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Lock  Is  Download  Prevented",
      "description": "Defines if the file can be downloaded while it is locked. Note: When passing parameters as JSON, use 'lock__is__download__prevented' (with double underscores)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateFile`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_FILE_REQUEST
Updates a file request in Box. File requests allow external users to upload files to a specific folder without needing a Box account. Use this action to modify file request settings such as title, description, status, and form requirements. Common use cases: - Activate or deactivate a file request by changing its status - Update the title or description shown to uploaders - Set or change form requirements (email, description) - Set an expiration date for the file request Note: File request IDs can only be obtained from the Box web application URL. There is no API endpoint to list all file requests. To find a file_request_id, navigate to the file request in Box web UI and copy the ID from the URL (e.g., https://*.app.box.com/filerequest/123).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "The new title for the file request. This is displayed to uploaders on the file request form. If not provided, the existing title is retained."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "inactive"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "FileRequestStatus",
      "description": "Status of the file request."
    },
    "if_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "description": "The etag of the file request. Pass this to ensure the file request hasn't changed since you last retrieved it. If the etag doesn't match, the update will fail with a 412 Precondition Failed error."
    },
    "expires_at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expires At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The date after which the file request will no longer accept submissions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z'). After this date, the status is automatically set to 'inactive'. If not provided, the existing expiration is retained. Set to null to remove expiration."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "The new description for the file request. This is displayed to uploaders on the file request form. If not provided, the existing description is retained."
    },
    "file_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Request Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the file request to update. This ID can be found in the Box web application URL when viewing a file request (e.g., for URL 'https://*.app.box.com/filerequest/123', the file_request_id is '123'). Note: File request IDs cannot be listed via API and must be obtained from the Box web interface."
    },
    "is_email_required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Email Required",
      "description": "Whether uploaders must provide their email address when submitting files. When true, an email field is shown on the file request form. If not provided, the existing setting is retained."
    },
    "is_description_required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Description Required",
      "description": "Whether uploaders must provide a description when submitting files. When true, a description field is shown on the file request form. If not provided, the existing setting is retained."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateFileRequest`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_FOLDER
Updates a folder. This can be also be used to move the folder, create shared links, update collaborations, and more.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "The optional new name for this folder."
    },
    "tags": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Tags",
      "description": "The tags for this item. These tags are shown in the Box web app and mobile apps next to an item. To add or remove a tag, retrieve the item\"s current tags, modify them, and then update this field. There is a limit of 100 tags per item, and 10,000 unique tags per enterprise. "
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
```

## BOX_UPDATE_GROUP
Updates a specific group. Only admins of this group or users with admin-level permissions will be able to use this API.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "The new name for the group. Must be unique within the enterprise."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",

Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "description": "The ID of the group."
    },
    "provenance": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Provenance",
      "description": "Keeps track of which external source this group is coming, for example `Active Directory`, or `Okta`. Setting this will also prevent Box admins from editing the group name and its members directly via the Box web application. This is desirable for one-way syncing of groups. "
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "A human readable description of the group."
    },
    "invitability_level": {
      "enum": [
        "admins_and_members",
        "admins_only",
        "all_managed_users"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "InvitabilityLevelEnm0",
      "description": "Specifies who can invite the group to collaborate on folders. When set to `admins_only` the enterprise admin, co-admins, and the group\"s admin can invite the group. When set to `admins_and_members` all the admins listed above and group members can invite the group. When set to `all_managed_users` all managed users in the enterprise can invite the group. "
    },
    "external_sync_identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External Sync Identifier",
      "description": "An arbitrary identifier that can be used by external group sync tools to link this Box Group to an external group. Example values of this field could be an **Active Directory Object ID** or a **Google Group ID**. We recommend you use of this field in order to avoid issues when group names are updated in either Box or external systems. "
    },
    "member_viewability_level": {
      "enum": [
        "admins_and_members",
        "admins_only",
        "all_managed_users"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MemberViewabilityLevelEnm0",
      "description": "Specifies who can see the members of the group. * `admins_only` - the enterprise admin, co-admins, group\"s   group admin * `admins_and_members` - all admins and group members * `all_managed_users` - all managed users in the   enterprise "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateGroup`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_GROUP_MEMBERSHIP
Updates a user's group membership. Only admins of this group or users with admin-level permissions will be able to use this API.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateGroupMembershipRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_membership_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "admin",
        "member"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "RoleEnm0",
      "description": "The role of the user in the group. Valid values are 'admin' (group administrator with configurable permissions) or 'member' (regular group member)."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested. "
    },
    "group_membership_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Membership Id",
      "description": "The ID of the group membership to update. You can obtain this ID from the 'add_user_to_group' action response or by listing group members with 'list_members_of_group'."
    },
    "configurable_permissions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Configurable Permissions",
      "description": "Custom configuration for the permissions a group admin will receive. This option has no effect on members with a role of 'member'. Available permission keys: 'can_create_accounts', 'can_edit_accounts', 'can_instant_login', 'can_run_reports'. Setting these permissions overwrites the default access levels of an admin. Omitted permissions will be enabled by default. Example: {'can_create_accounts': false, 'can_run_reports': true}.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "boolean"
      }
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateGroupMembership`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_LEGAL_HOLD_POLICY
Update an existing legal hold policy in Box. This action allows you to modify the name, description, and release notes of an existing legal hold policy. Legal hold policies are used to preserve content for litigation or compliance purposes. At least one of the optional parameters (policy_name, description, or release_notes) should be provided. Note: This is a Box Governance feature that requires an enterprise account with legal hold capabilities enabled. The authenticated user must have admin-level permissions with the 'manage_legal_holds' scope.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateLegalHoldPolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "legal_hold_policy_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "A new description for the legal hold policy. Maximum 500 characters."
    },
    "policy_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Policy Name",
      "description": "The new name for the legal hold policy. Maximum 254 characters."
    },
    "release_notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Release Notes",
      "description": "Notes explaining why the policy was released or any relevant release information. Maximum 500 characters."
    },
    "legal_hold_policy_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Legal Hold Policy Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the legal hold policy to update. You can obtain this ID from the response of BOX_CREATE_LEGAL_HOLD_POLICY or BOX_LIST_ALL_LEGAL_HOLD_POLICIES."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateLegalHoldPolicy`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_METADATA_INSTANCE_ON_FILE
Updates a metadata instance on a file using JSON-Patch operations. The metadata template must already be applied to the file before it can be updated. Only values that match the template schema are accepted. The update is atomic - if any operation fails, no changes are applied.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateMetadataInstanceOnFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id",
    "scope",
    "template_key",
    "operations"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "examples": [
        "global",
        "enterprise"
      ],
      "description": "The scope of the metadata template. Use 'global' for Box-provided templates available to all enterprises, or 'enterprise' for templates created within your enterprise. The 'enterprise' value will be automatically converted to the format 'enterprise_{enterprise_id}' if needed."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "987654321"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`."
    },
    "operations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "MetadataUpdateOperation",
        "required": [
          "op",
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "op": {
            "enum": [
              "add",
              "replace",
              "remove",
              "test",
              "move",
              "copy"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Op",
            "description": "The JSON-Patch operation type to perform. 'add' creates or overwrites a field value, 'replace' updates an existing field, 'remove' deletes a field, 'test' verifies a field value, 'move' relocates a value, 'copy' duplicates a value."
          },
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "From",
            "examples": [
              "/nextState",
              "/previousValue"
            ],
            "description": "The source JSON-Pointer path for 'move' or 'copy' operations. Must be in JSON-Pointer format (e.g., '/sourceField'). Required for 'move' and 'copy' operations only."
          },
          "path": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Path",
            "examples": [
              "/currentState",
              "/author",
              "/reviewStatus"
            ],
            "description": "The JSON-Pointer path to the metadata field, always prefixed with '/'. For example: '/fieldName' or '/author'. Reserved characters ~ and / must be escaped as ~0 and ~1 respectively."
          },
          "value": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "type": "number"
              },
              {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "anyOf": [
                    {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "integer"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "number"
                    },
                    {
                      "type": "boolean"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            ],
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "reviewed",
              42,
              [
                "tag1",
                "tag2"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "The value to set or test. Required for 'add', 'replace', and 'test' operations. Type must match the metadata template field definition (string, number, array, etc.)."
          }
        },
        "description": "A JSON-Patch operation for updating metadata instance fields."
      },
      "title": "Operations",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "A JSON-Patch array of operations to apply to the metadata instance. The update is atomic - if any operation fails, no changes are applied. Operations are executed in the order provided."
    },
    "template_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Key",
      "examples": [
        "properties",
        "contractTemplate",
        "invoiceMetadata"
      ],
      "description": "The name (key) of the metadata template. For example, 'properties' for the standard Box properties template, or a custom template key for enterprise templates."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating metadata instance on a file using JSON-Patch operations."
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_METADATA_INSTANCE_ON_FOLDER
Updates metadata on a folder using JSON-Patch operations (RFC 6902). The metadata template must already be applied to the folder. Only values matching the template schema are accepted (except global.properties which accepts any key-value pairs). All operations are applied atomically - if any fail, no changes are made.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateMetadataInstanceOnFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id",
    "scope",
    "template_key",
    "operations"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "examples": [
        "global",
        "enterprise"
      ],
      "description": "The scope of the metadata template. Use 'global' for global templates (like 'properties') or 'enterprise' for enterprise-specific templates. For enterprise templates, you can use either 'enterprise' or the full format 'enterprise_{enterprise_id}'."
    },
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "353353898191"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a folder. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder of a Box account is always represented by the ID `0`."
    },
    "operations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "MetadataPatchOperation",
        "required": [
          "op",
          "path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "op": {
            "enum": [
              "add",
              "replace",
              "remove",
              "test",
              "move",
              "copy"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Op",
            "examples": [
              "replace",
              "add"
            ],
            "description": "The type of change to perform: 'add' creates or overwrites a field, 'replace' updates an existing field, 'remove' deletes a field, 'test' verifies a value, 'move' relocates a value, 'copy' duplicates a value."
          },
          "from": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "From",
            "examples": [
              "/oldField"
            ],
            "description": "The source location in JSON-Pointer format to move or copy a value from. Required only for 'move' and 'copy' operations."
```

## BOX_UPDATE_METADATA_TEMPLATE
Updates a metadata template by applying JSON-Patch operations. The template must already exist. The update is applied atomically - if any error occurs during the application of operations, the metadata template will not be changed. Use this to modify template properties, add/edit/remove fields, or manage enum/multiSelect options.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateMetadataTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "scope",
    "template_key",
    "operations"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scope",
      "description": "The scope of the metadata template. Use 'global' for global templates or 'enterprise' for enterprise-specific templates. For enterprise templates, you can also use the full scope format like 'enterprise_123456'."
    },
    "operations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "MetadataTemplateUpdateOperation",
        "required": [
          "op"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "op": {
            "enum": [
              "editTemplate",
              "addField",
              "reorderFields",
              "addEnumOption",
              "reorderEnumOptions",
              "reorderMultiSelectOptions",
              "addMultiSelectOption",
              "editField",
              "removeField",
              "editEnumOption",
              "removeEnumOption",
              "editMultiSelectOption",
              "removeMultiSelectOption"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Op",
            "description": "The type of change to perform on the template. Some operations are hazardous as they will change existing templates. Available operations: editTemplate (update template properties), addField (add new field), reorderFields (change field order), addEnumOption (add enum option), reorderEnumOptions (reorder enum options), reorderMultiSelectOptions (reorder multi-select options), addMultiSelectOption (add multi-select option), editField (modify field properties), removeField (delete field), editEnumOption (modify enum option), removeEnumOption (delete enum option), editMultiSelectOption (modify multi-select option), removeMultiSelectOption (delete multi-select option)."
          },
          "data": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Data",
            "description": "The data for the operation. This varies depending on the operation being performed. For editTemplate: {'displayName': 'New Name'}. For addField: complete field definition. For editField/editEnumOption/editMultiSelectOption: properties to update.",
            "additionalProperties": true
          },
          "fieldKey": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Field Key",
            "description": "For operations that affect a single field, this defines the key of the field that is affected. Required for editField, removeField operations."
          },
          "fieldKeys": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Field Keys",
            "description": "For operations that affect multiple fields, this defines the keys of the fields that are affected. Used for reorderFields operation."
          },
          "enumOptionKey": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Enum Option Key",
            "description": "For operations that affect a single enum option, this defines the key of the option that is affected. Used for editEnumOption, removeEnumOption."
          },
          "enumOptionKeys": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Enum Option Keys",
            "description": "For operations that affect multiple enum options, this defines the keys of the options that are affected. Used for reorderEnumOptions."
          },
          "multiSelectOptionKey": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Multi Select Option Key",
            "description": "For operations that affect a single multi-select option, this defines the key of the option that is affected. Used for editMultiSelectOption, removeMultiSelectOption."
          },
          "multiSelectOptionKeys": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Multi Select Option Keys",
            "description": "For operations that affect multiple multi-select options, this defines the keys of the options that are affected. Used for reorderMultiSelectOptions."
          }
        },
        "description": "A JSON-Patch operation for updating a metadata template."
      },
      "title": "Operations",
      "description": "A list of JSON-Patch operations to apply to the metadata template. The operations are applied atomically - if any operation fails, the entire update is rolled back. Each operation must specify an 'op' field and may include 'data', 'fieldKey', 'fieldKeys', 'enumOptionKey', 'enumOptionKeys', 'multiSelectOptionKey', or 'multiSelectOptionKeys' depending on the operation type."
    },
    "template_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Template Key",
      "description": "The name of the metadata template (templateKey). For example: 'properties' for the global.properties template, or a custom template key. This identifier is unique within the scope of the template."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateMetadataTemplate`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_RETENTION_POLICY
Updates an existing Box retention policy. Use this action to modify retention policy settings such as name, description, retention duration, disposition action, and notification settings. Requires Box Governance add-on and 'manage retention policies' scope. Note: Non-modifiable policies have limited update options (can only extend duration, add folders, retire policy, or change notification settings).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateRetentionPolicyRequest",
  "required": [
    "retention_policy_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "retired"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "PolicyStatus",
      "description": "Status of the retention policy."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "A text description of the retention policy. Maximum 500 characters. Set to empty string to clear the existing description."
    },
    "policy_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Policy Name",
      "description": "The new name for the retention policy. Must be unique within the enterprise."
    },
    "retention_type": {
      "enum": [
        "modifiable",
        "non-modifiable"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "RetentionType",
      "description": "Specifies whether the policy can be modified."
    },
    "retention_length": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Retention Length",
      "description": "The retention duration in days as an integer (e.g., 30, 365) or the string 'indefinite' for indefinite policies. Non-modifiable policies can only have their duration extended, not shortened."
    },
    "disposition_action": {
      "enum": [
        "permanently_delete",
        "remove_retention"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "DispositionAction",
      "description": "Action to take when the retention policy expires."
    },
    "are_owners_notified": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Are Owners Notified",
      "description": "Whether to notify owners and co-owners when retention is about to expire. Notifications are sent before the retention duration ends."
    },
    "retention_policy_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Retention Policy Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the retention policy to update."
    },
    "can_owner_extend_retention": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Can Owner Extend Retention",
      "description": "Whether content owners can extend the retention period before it expires. When true, owners see an option to extend retention on their files."
    },
    "custom_notification_recipients": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "UserMini",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier for the user to notify."
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "user"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "UserType",
            "default": "user",
            "description": "Type of user object."
          }
        },
        "description": "A mini representation of a user for notification recipients.",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Custom Notification Recipients",
      "description": "A list of additional users to notify when retention is about to expire. Each user should be specified with their 'id' field. Example: [{'id': '12345678'}]"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating a Box retention policy.\n\nRetention policies prevent permanent deletion of content for a specified duration.\nOnly fields that you wish to change should be provided; omitted fields remain unchanged.",
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_SHARED_LINK_ON_FILE
Updates a shared link on a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSharedLinkOnFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Explicitly request the `shared_link` fields to be returned for this item. Defaults to 'shared_link' to return the shared link details after update."
    },
    "file_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represents a file. The ID for any file can be determined by visiting a file in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123` the `file_id` is `123`. "
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the folder (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Set the password to `null` to remove it. Passwords must now be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for editing of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. This value can only be `true` if `can_download` is also `true`. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
```

## BOX_UPDATE_SHARED_LINK_ON_FOLDER
Updates a shared link on a folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSharedLinkOnFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Explicitly request the `shared_link` fields to be returned for this item. Defaults to 'shared_link' to include the updated shared link information in the response."
    },
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier that represent a folder. The ID for any folder can be determined by visiting this folder in the web application and copying the ID from the URL. For example, for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/folder/123` the `folder_id` is `123`. The root folder of a Box account is always represented by the ID `0`. "
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the folder (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Set the password to `null` to remove it. Passwords must now be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "This value can only be `false` for items with a `type` of `folder`."
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for previewing of files. This value is always `true`. For shared links on folders this also applies to any items in the folder. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__download": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Download",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for downloading of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateSharedLinkOnFolder`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_SHARED_LINK_ON_WEB_LINK
Updates a shared link on a web link.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSharedLinkOnWebLinkRequest",
  "required": [
    "web_link_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fields": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Fields",
      "default": "shared_link",
      "description": "Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use 'shared_link' to return the shared link information in the response. "
    },
    "web_link_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Web Link Id",
      "description": "The ID of the web link."
    },
    "shared__link__access": {
      "enum": [
        "collaborators",
        "company",
        "open"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AccessEnm0",
      "description": "The level of access for the shared link. This can be restricted to anyone with the link (`open`), only people within the company (`company`) and only those who have been invited to the folder (`collaborators`). If not set, this field defaults to the access level specified by the enterprise admin. To create a shared link with this default setting pass the `shared_link` object with no `access` field, for example `{ \"shared_link\": {} }`. The `company` access level is only available to paid accounts. "
    },
    "shared__link__password": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Password",
      "description": "The password required to access the shared link. Note: Password protection may not be supported for web links and could result in an error. If supported, passwords must be at least eight characters long and include a number, upper case letter, or a non-numeric or non-alphabetic character. A password can only be set when `access` is set to `open`. "
    },
    "shared__link__unshared__at": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Unshared  At",
      "format": "date-time",
      "description": "The timestamp at which this shared link will expire. This field can only be set by users with paid accounts. The value must be greater than the current date and time. "
    },
    "shared__link__vanity__name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Vanity  Name",
      "description": "Defines a custom vanity name to use in the shared link URL, for example `https://app.box.com/v/my-shared-link`. Custom URLs should not be used when sharing sensitive content as vanity URLs are a lot easier to guess than regular shared links. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__edit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Edit",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for editing. This parameter is not applicable to web links and will be ignored. It can only be set for files."
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__preview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Preview",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for previewing of files. This value is always `true`. For shared links on folders this also applies to any items in the folder. "
    },
    "shared__link__permissions__can__download": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shared  Link  Permissions  Can  Download",
      "description": "If the shared link allows for downloading of files. This can only be set when `access` is set to `open` or `company`. "
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateSharedLinkOnWebLink`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_SHIELD_INFORMATION_BARRIER_STATUS
Change the status of a shield information barrier. Shield information barriers are ethical walls that prevent exchanges or communication between individuals/groups within the same enterprise to avoid conflicts of interest. This action allows you to: - Set status to 'pending': Transition a barrier from 'draft' status in preparation for enablement - Set status to 'disabled': Deactivate an enabled or pending barrier Note: Barriers cannot be directly enabled via this endpoint. The 'enabled' status is set automatically by Box after all required segments and restrictions are configured on a 'pending' barrier.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateShieldInformationBarrierStatusRequest",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the shield information barrier to update. You can get this ID from BOX_LIST_SHIELD_INFORMATION_BARRIERS or BOX_CREATE_SHIELD_INFORMATION_BARRIER."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "disabled",
        "pending"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Status",
      "description": "The desired status for the shield information barrier. Use 'pending' to prepare the barrier for enablement (transition from draft), or 'disabled' to deactivate an active barrier."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateShieldInformationBarrierStatus`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_SLACK_INTEGRATION_MAPPING
Updates an existing [Slack integration mapping](https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415585987859-Box-as-the-Content-Layer-for-Slack). Use this to change which Box folder is mapped to a Slack channel, or to update configuration options like automatic access management. Requires Admin or Co-Admin role and the 'manage_enterprise_properties' scope. At least one of 'box_item' or 'options' must be provided.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSlackIntegrationMappingRequest",
  "required": [
    "integration_mapping_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "options": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MappingOptions",
      "properties": {
        "is_access_management_disabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Access Management Disabled",
          "description": "If true, disables automatic access management for this mapping. When disabled, Box will not automatically create collaborations or shared links based on Slack channel membership."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration options for the integration mapping.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "box_item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "BoxItem",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The ID of the Box folder to map to the Slack channel. The Box service account must be an owner or co-owner of this folder."
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "default": "folder",
          "description": "The type of Box item. Must be 'folder'."
        }
      },
      "description": "Box folder information for the integration mapping update.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "integration_mapping_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Integration Mapping Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Slack integration mapping to update. Obtain this ID from the 'list_slack_integration_mappings' action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateSlackIntegrationMapping`"
}
```

## BOX_UPDATE_STORAGE_POLICY_ASSIGNMENT
Updates a storage policy assignment for an enterprise or user. Storage policies control where data is stored geographically (data residency). Use this action to change which storage policy is assigned to a user or enterprise. This action requires Box Zones or similar enterprise feature to be enabled and admin-level permissions with 'manage_enterprise_properties' scope. Use 'list_storage_policies' to get available policies and 'list_storage_policy_assignments' to find existing assignment IDs.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateStoragePolicyAssignmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "storage_policy_assignment_id",
    "storage__policy__id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "storage__policy__id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Storage  Policy  Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the new storage policy to assign to the user or enterprise. Get available policies using the 'list_storage_policies' action."
    },
    "storage__policy__type": {
      "enum": [
        "storage_policy"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Storage  Policy  Type",
      "default": "storage_policy",
      "description": "The type of policy to assign. Must be 'storage_policy'. This field is fixed and agents typically don't need to specify it."
    },
    "storage_policy_assignment_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Storage Policy Assignment Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the storage policy assignment to update. Obtain this ID from the 'list_storage_policy_assignments' action or from a previous 'assign_storage_policy' response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateStoragePolicyAssignment`"
}
```
